objects.text: FIELD ATLAS   /   SECTION THROUGH THE SHADOW
Schematic section · distances and sizes enlarged for clarity
The Moon usually passes above or below the alignment.

audio.caption: From the ground, a solar eclipse begins when the Moon moves across the face of the Sun.
From space, the same event is a shadow. Inside its darkest part, the Moon hides the entire bright disk.
The lunar orbit is tilted. A solar eclipse needs a new moon near a node, where the two orbital planes cross.
